subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers adopt or refresh one of the open conflicting fork PRs, or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but current labels plus conflicting open fork candidates mean automation should not open another duplicate branch until maintainers choose the repair path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Close or leave the fork PRs as source context, then queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused regression tests and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh one fork PR
options.body: Pick the better fork candidate, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage and live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep the issue open until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and real Feishu proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Close or leave the fork PRs as source context, then queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused regression tests and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path history and current payload-builder adjacency make this the strongest routing candidate for choosing the fix path.
